scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w back-end" "npm run dev -w front-end"
scripts.build: npm run build -w back-end && npm run build -w front-end
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w back-end && npm run lint -w front-end
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w back-end && npm run typecheck -w front-end
scripts.test: npm run test -w back-end && npm run test -w front-end
